question: Should OpenClaw add a default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring config, fold this into the broader origin-delivery policy, or keep Control UI delivery explicit-only?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the behavior crosses channel/privacy boundaries and adds config surface, so automation should not choose the product and security policy.

options.title: Decide under origin-delivery policy
options.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

options.title: Ship narrow default-off mirroring
options.body: Add the requested session config only after maintainers accept a separate WebChat mirroring policy and require live Discord or Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep explicit delivery only
options.body: Close or defer this feature if maintainers decide WebChat should never reuse stored external routes without explicit per-message delivery intent.

recommendation.title: Decide under origin-delivery policy
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the narrow WebChat mirroring requirement while defining shared route freshness, authorization, and duplicate-delivery rules with the broader origin-delivery work.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the current assignee and has the strongest recent history on the WebChat route-safety surface.
